answer: Send every answer to graders drawn at random from accounts older than a long cooling period, the way snow must settle for years before it counts as glacier. A farm cannot choose who reviews its clones, so each fake makes a solo voyage past strangers. Aliases parked in a quiet lagoon to age still face those random graders every epoch, and the farm only steers outcomes after it controls a large share of the seasoned pool, which takes months of real, independently judged work.
